labels.text: section 4941(a)(1): 10 percent of the amount involved, per year (or part thereof) in the taxable period, paid by the disqualified person

10 percent — the current pinned text of section 4941(a)(1); the 1970-01-01 coverage start follows the Tax Reform Act of 1969 (Pub. L. 91-172), which enacted this section, but no pinned note in this package's sources.law confirms the exact effective date for the (a)(1) rate itself (no amendment to it is flagged in the pinned notes) — the RATE is pinned current text, the COVERAGE START date is an unverified boundary, not invented for lack of a value
